notes: A new class: River! Made by (and for) a very special player

River is a sneaky, fast and tough fire-and-flower fighter in a black and pink crop top and shorts, playable as any race. She flicks burning petals, cracks briar whips, slips through the shadows, and plants gardens of flame
Her signature move is a deafening scream that sends foes running in terror (scared foes take extra damage)
Easter egg: wherever fire burns out, flowers bloom in the flames. And when she levels up, she has something to say
Full kit: 8 skills with evolutions, 3 talent trees, 5 armor sets, 5 achievements, an ultimate (Midnight Scream), her own select scene and sounds. Costs 1200 Shards
